hero.title: Mauryan Administrative Offices
hero.description: A comprehensive study of the highly centralized bureaucratic structure of the Mauryan Empire as described by Kautilya and Megasthenes.

cards.details: Chandragupta Maurya establishes the empire; Chanakya codifies the Saptanga theory of state.
Ashoka expands the bureaucracy with Dhamma-mahamattas to regulate socio-moral order.

traps.title: UPSC Common Exam Traps
items: The 'Saptanga Theory' is Kautilya's, not Ashoka's; Ashoka added 'Dhamma-mahamattas' which were not in the Arthashastra.

deepDive.title: Syllabus Core Study Notes (Deep-Dive)
deepDive.description: Master the key concepts and dimensions of this topic.

sections.title: 1. Core Study Notes
sections.content:
Central Level

  • Mantriparishad (Council of Ministers)
  • Tirthas (18 highest ranking officials)

Local Level

  • Pradeshika (Provincial)
  • Rajuka (Survey/Justice)
  • Yuktas (Subordinates)
  • Key Offices:
    • Tirthas: 18 High-ranking officials like Mantri, Purohita, Senapati.
    • Adhyakshas: Superintendents of economic departments (e.g., Panyadhyaksha for trade, Sitadhyaksha for agriculture).
    • Dhamma-mahamattas: Introduced by Ashoka for the propagation of Dhamma.
    • Gudha-purushas: Secret agents/spies forming the backbone of Mauryan intelligence.
